usage.reason: The provided documentation describes per-user report parameters (such as accounts:timestamp_last_login) but not the report endpoint path, and it does not show the user record fields. The audit log samples shown are admin, token and user_accounts changes, which do not reliably show product use. A confirmed per-user activity source could not be identified.

evidence.quote: Retrieves a paginated list of either deleted users or all users in a domain.
You can also use the my_customer alias to represent your account's customerId
Token to specify next page in the list. The page token is only valid for three days.
Token used to access next page of this result.
The time when the user last logged into the user's account.

assumptions: The pasted documentation did not include the User object fields. The field names id, primaryEmail, name.fullName, suspended, lastLoginTime and creationTime come from general knowledge of the Directory API and were not confirmed in the source.

The source does not give Google's OAuth sign-in or token addresses, so they are left out. The connection expects an OAuth access token that already has the admin.directory.user.readonly scope, sent as the access_token query parameter shown in the source's sample requests. Such tokens normally expire, and how to obtain and renew them is not described in the source.
Google service accounts with domain-wide delegation would survive staff leaving, but the manifest format has no way to express them and the source does not describe them.
The maximum maxResults value is not stated in the source. 500 was used as a sensible value.
Deleted users (showDeleted=true) are not fetched. Suspended users are included, and the 'suspended' flag is mapped to status.
Usage is marked unavailable. The per-user report parameter timestamp_last_login exists, but its endpoint path was not in the source, so it was not guessed.
Rate limits were not stated in the source and are left empty.
Role and user type were not mapped because the source does not show matching fields.
